title: Embedding space version can disagree with the returned vector dimension
reasoning: The response dimension is computed from the actual embedding length, but embedding_space_version is built from embedding_provider.dimension. When the provider does not expose dimension, exposes a stale dimension, or changes runtime fallback behavior, the same response can report dimension=len(embedding_list) while embedding_space_version contains unknown-dimension or a different provider dimension. Since the route documents this version as the compatibility key for local FAISS indexes, a mismatched version can make clients reuse incompatible indexes or unnecessarily rebuild compatible ones.
recommendation: Derive embedding_space_version from the actual returned embedding dimension in response-producing paths, or verify provider.dimension matches len(embedding_list) and fail with a clear provider contract error when it does not.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were included for providers without a dimension attribute or with a dimension that differs from the returned embedding length.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add service tests with a fake provider returning a 3-element embedding while dimension is missing or set to a conflicting value; assert embedding_space_version uses or validates the actual returned dimension consistently with response.dimension.
